$comment: Pre-approves the safe, local commands this kit uses so Claude can scrape on autopilot without a permission prompt each time. All entries are local-only (localhost / this folder's scripts / docker). Nothing here can reach the public internet except the scraper's own outbound calls. NOTE: `docker compose down` is allowed as an EXACT match only — `:*` would also pre-approve `down -v`, which deletes every scraped result. Data-destroying variants are denied below so they always prompt.
